verses.3422: jaddafī sayrihā falasta tulāmu hadhihi ṭaybatu wahadha l-maqāmu
verses.3423: ḥaramu ḥallahu nabiyu karīmu waʾimāmu bijanabihi wahumāmu
verses.3424: wajalālu. wahaybatu wawaqāru wabahāʾāʾu warifʿahu wa ḥtirāmu
verses.3425: hāhunā faṣ-ṣiqi l-faʾā dalituṭfā ḥuraqu shabbahā l-hawā waḍirāmu
verses.3426: mut hunā law ʿaha washawqā wawajdā wagharāmā famā ʿalayka malāmu
verses.3427: naḥnu fī rawḍaḍi r-rasūli julūsu hadhihi yaqẓaḍu waʾillā manāmu
verses.3428: falaku fī s-suʿūdi qadḥḥala fīhi qamaru ẓallalat ʿalayhi l-ghamāmu
verses.3429: kayfa lā taskubu d-dumūʿa jufūnī wahyā min qabli ʾantarāka sijāmu
verses.3430: kayfa lā tadhhalu l-ʿaqūlu watafnā ʾanfusu l-ʿāshiqīna wahyā kirāmu
verses.3431: yārasūla l-ʾilahi ʾinnī muḥibbu laka wallāhi shāʾā ʾiqu mustahāmu
verses.3432: yārasūla l-ʾilahi fī kulli ḥīni laka minnī taḥḥiyatu wasalāmu
verses.3433: yārasūla l-ʾilahi shawqī ʿaẓīmu zā ʾidu wa l-gharāmu fīka gharāmu
verses.3434: yārasūla l-ʾilahi jiʾituka ʾasʿā qayyadatnī dh-dhu nūbu wahyā ʿiẓāmu
verses.3435: yārasūla l-ʾilahi ʾinī nazīlu wanazīlu l-kirāmi laysa yuḍāmu
verses.3436: ʾantumu maqṣadī lifaqri waminkum tuʿrafu l-jūdu wa l-wafā wa dh-dhimāmu
verses.3437: walakum ḥur mahu wajāhu ʿaẓīmu wawafāʾu warifʿahu llā turāmu
verses.3438: laylata l-ʾisrāʾā ʾahlu kulli samāʾi sajada l-kullu ʾidhra ʾawka waqāmū
verses.3439: wataqaddamta liṣ-ṣalāti faṣallū kulluhum muqtadi waʾanta l-ʾimāmu
verses.3440: yānajiyyā l-ʾilahi fī ḥaḍrati l-qudsi karīmu lahu hunāka yuqāmu
verses.3441: ʾanta nūru l-ʿuyūni ʾanta l-ʾamānī ʾanta rūḥu l-qulūbi ʾanta l-humāmu
verses.3442: ʾanta yā sayyida n-nabīʾīna baḥru sabiḥa l-kullu fī nadāka waʿāmū
verses.3443: ʾanta lil-kulli ʾawwalu fī l-maʿālī wakadhā ʾanta lil-jamīʿi khiyāmu
verses.3444: ẓaharat kal-budūri nūrā waḥusnā fī samāʾi l-ʿulā waʾanta t-tamāmu
verses.3445: watabiddat lanā kaʿiqdi nafīsi rāqa ḥusnā waʾanta n-niẓāmu
verses.3446: yānabiyyā l-hudā maʿā nīka tutlā ʿajazat ʾan tanālahā l-ʾafhāmu
verses.3447: kayfa lāyartajī bnu masʿūdi ʿafwā walahu munka ḥurmahu wadhimāmu
verses.3448: yamdaḥu l-madḥa kulla yawmi biwaṣfi fīka yāman bihi yuzānu l-kalāmu
verses.3449: yā ʾilaha s-samāʾi ṣalli ʿalayhi kullamā dāma liz-za māni dawāmu
verses.3450: waʿalā ʾālihi ʾajalli l-barāyā waʿalā ṣaḥbihi l-jamīʿi s-salāmu
